offending_extra_words: (provided that no settlement imposing any liability or admission on the indemnified party may be made without its prior written consent)

If the Licensed Technology becomes, or in Licensor's opinion is likely to become, the subject of an infringement claim, Licensor shall at its expense procure for Licensee the right to continue using the Licensed Technology, or modify or replace it so that it is non-infringing, or, if neither is commercially reasonable, refund the fees paid by Licensee.
(iii) Licensee's use of the Licensed Technology in material breach of this Agreement
provided that Licensee shall have no obligation under this paragraph to the extent a claim arises out of the Licensed Technology itself or Licensor's acts or omissions
reasons: All atomic elements of the preferred position are present in operative language: Vendor defence/indemnity for IP infringement, breach of law, Vendor-caused data incidents and gross negligence/wilful misconduct, standard notice/control/cooperation, and a Customer indemnity narrowed to Customer content and Customer breach of law. Preferred level is complete.

Fallback is incomplete (no modification/combination/specification exclusions and no 3x annual fees super-cap), but that is irrelevant since the locked target is preferred; the two levels must not be mixed.
Minimality fails: the insert imports the fallback-only procure/modify/replace/refund remedy chain into a preferred-level redline.
Minimality also fails for hold-harmless language and settlement-consent mechanics beyond the preferred 'notice, control, cooperation' trio.

The Customer-side rewrite goes beyond the preferred limitation by adding a third limb ('use ... in material breach of this Agreement') and a broad new carve-out proviso, rather than simply narrowing to Customer content and Customer breach of law; the official gate also records changed-character ratios of 0.896 and 0.950 on operations 1 and 2.

Intent is otherwise preserved: Article XIII is left intact except for the express override needed to make the new indemnity effective, and no contradiction or dangling mechanic is created; note only that 'API's' is used as an undefined descriptor.
